import type postgres from "postgres";
import { dbOf } from "./module-db.ts";
const sql = dbOf("content");
const parts = Object.assign(["SELECT id FROM receipts"], { raw: ["SELECT id FROM receipts"] });
export async function directTemplate() { return await sql`SELECT id FROM receipts`; }
export async function directCall() { return await sql(parts); }
export async function callTemplate() { return await sql.call(undefined, parts); }
export async function applyTemplate() { return await sql.apply(undefined, [parts]); }
const bound = sql.bind(undefined);
export async function boundTemplate() { return await bound`SELECT id FROM receipts`; }
export async function boundCall() { return await bound(parts); }
const localSignature: (strings: TemplateStringsArray) => postgres.PendingQuery<postgres.Row[]> = sql;
export async function retypedTemplate() { return await localSignature`SELECT id FROM receipts`; }
export async function retypedCall() { return await localSignature(parts); }
const wrapped = (strings: TemplateStringsArray) => sql(strings);
export async function wrappedTemplate() { return await wrapped`SELECT id FROM receipts`; }
export async function callUnsafe() { return await sql.unsafe.call(undefined, "SELECT id FROM receipts"); }
export async function applyUnsafe() { return await sql.unsafe.apply(undefined, ["SELECT id FROM receipts"]); }
const boundUnsafe = sql.unsafe.bind(undefined);
export async function boundUnsafeCall() { return await boundUnsafe("SELECT id FROM receipts"); }
export async function directUnsafe() { return await sql.unsafe("SELECT id FROM receipts"); }
export async function bracketUnsafe() { return await sql["unsafe"]("SELECT id FROM receipts"); }
const promiseSignature: (strings: TemplateStringsArray) => PromiseLike<postgres.Row[]> = sql;
export async function promiseRetypedTemplate() { return await promiseSignature`SELECT id FROM receipts`; }
const promiseUnsafe: (text: string) => PromiseLike<postgres.Row[]> = sql.unsafe;
export async function promiseRetypedUnsafe() { return await promiseUnsafe("SELECT id FROM receipts"); }
export async function close() { await sql.end(); }

export async function extraSatisfiesTag() { return await (promiseSignature satisfies typeof promiseSignature)`SELECT id FROM receipts`; }
export async function extraBracketCall() { return await promiseSignature["call"](undefined, parts); }
const erasedBound=promiseUnsafe["bind"](undefined);
export async function extraBracketBind() { return await erasedBound("SELECT id FROM receipts"); }
